items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I played with him about twice over there.

ctx.x: When did he go to Mexico? Ask him about that trip.

So when did you go to Mexico? I went to Mexico in 1926. I stayed over there three months and a half. I paid with a white band over there. I paid with a 110. Professor Connett, that's what his name was. And I got scared of him. I thought I couldn't hear the word. But I'm sure were the places where he was the same thing. I'd say, I'd say, they're the same as A, B, C, D, you know. But I got along good with him. I played with him about twice over there. Then I played with another little four piece band over there.…
